import Mathlib
open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Limits MonoidalCategory
open CartesianMonoidalCategory MonObj

-- control: unit section closed immersion, mathlib only
example {K : Type u} [Field K] (G : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) [GrpObj G] :
    IsClosedImmersion (η[G]).left := by
  infer_instance

-- the real question: any mathlib route (not just instances) to separatedness?
example {K : Type u} [Field K] (G : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) [GrpObj G] :
    IsSeparated G.hom := by
  exact?
